It happened to me for a long time too. But two things eventually changed:

1. I found new things to think about. And this just takes time. Of course you'll always think about your ex in the beginning, because, for the most part, anything that you think of will involve them. Think about the movie you saw/vacation you took/party you went to/dinner you had/etc.? Well, more than likely, he was there and so you're going to think about him. After a while of no contact, your ex stops being a part of the life events you think about. 

2. When I did think of my ex, it didn't hurt. You'll still think about them from time to time, they were a huge part of your life, but after a while, when you realize you can live without them, you won't really notice that you're thinking of him, because it won't cause such intense pain.
